evidence.title: U.S. ambassador's remarks spark new diplomatic row in Chile

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement issued by Brandon Judd on Wednesday night
occurrences.quote_span: In response to the criticism, Judd issued a statement Wednesday night denying that he had made Chilean sovereignty conditional on cooperation with Washington.
occurrences.speaker: Brandon Judd
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statement by Sen. Karim Bianchi
occurrences.quote_span: "The United States can be a partner, we can have the best of relations, but it is not our guardian," he said.
occurrences.speaker: Karim Bianchi
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Chilean Foreign Minister Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.quote_span: Foreign Minister Francisco Pérez Mackenna responded that Chile does not need foreign assistance to defend its territory.
occurrences.speaker: Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Joint statement by Senate President Paulina Núñez and Vice President Iván Moreira
occurrences.quote_span: "Our country's sovereignty is not up for discussion, nor does it depend on the backing, support or recognition of any foreign nation," they said.
occurrences.speaker: Paulina Núñez and Iván Moreira
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Chilean Defense Minister Fernando Barros
occurrences.quote_span: Defense Minister Fernando Barros had previously urged consideration of the context of Judd's remarks, noting that the ambassador had acknowledged Chilean sovereignty over the strait and highlighted bilateral cooperation on trade, technology and security.
occurrences.speaker: Fernando Barros
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Transcript or recording of Brandon Judd's Global Trade Day remarks
occurrences.quote_span: "If you want the resources we have to fight organized crime, if you want a country that will help you protect your rights over the Strait of Magellan, if you want all those things, then you're going to have to work with us on the things that are important to us as well," he said.
occurrences.speaker: Brandon Judd
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Global Trade Day event program and recording
occurrences.quote_span: The controversy began Wednesday when Judd spoke at Global Trade Day, an event organized by shipping company Compañía Sud Americana de Vapores (CSAV), where he discussed bilateral relations and Washington's strategic interests.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Chile Foreign Ministry records on a formal diplomatic protest
occurrences.quote_span: Pérez Mackenna said the government would assess whether to lodge a formal diplomatic protest over the U.S. ambassador's remarks.
occurrences.speaker: Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Brandon Judd about his CSAV event remarks
occurrences.quote_span: The ambassador also said his remarks at the CSAV event were intended to reaffirm bilateral ties and opportunities for cooperation between the two countries on security and economic development.
occurrences.speaker: Brandon Judd
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Chilean Foreign Minister Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.quote_span: "We can defend our sovereignty ourselves. We don't need anyone's support. That's how we've been doing it for 200 years," he added.
occurrences.speaker: Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement by Chilean Foreign Minister Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.quote_span: "The Strait of Magellan was, is and always will be Chilean," he emphasized.
occurrences.speaker: Francisco Pérez Mackenna
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Statement issued by Brandon Judd and reported by Radio Bío Bío
occurrences.quote_span: "I enjoy a good TV series as much as anyone, but this drama is being misrepresented. My words were clearly taken out of context, and at no point did I make Chile's sovereignty conditional," he said, according to a statement reported by Chilean news outlet Radio Bío Bío.
occurrences.speaker: Brandon Judd
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan

occurrences.checkable_against: Public statements by the Kast administration and Chilean lawmakers
occurrences.quote_span: His remarks drew criticism from President José Antonio Kast's administration and lawmakers across the political spectrum, who rejected the suggestion that bilateral cooperation could be tied to Chile's exercise of national sovereignty.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Brandon Judd's remarks about Chilean sovereignty over the Strait of Magellan
